newsitem.title: USA: Summa Four President,COO Callahan resigns.
newsitem.headline: Summa Four President,COO Callahan resigns.

text.p: Summa Four Inc said on Monday that Edward C. Callahan, president and chief operating officer, resigned his positions as well as his seat on the board of directors.
Barry Gorsun, chairman and chief executive officer, will assume the duties of president, the company said.
"The board and he had a difference of opinion as to the direction of the company," said Thomas St. Germain, chief financial officer.
"The company has experienced several quarters of flat revenues and the board is anxious to move in a direction of growth in a more agressive manner," St. Germain said.

In the company's second quarter, revenue totaled $9,982,000, level with revenue of $9,954,000 in the 1995 second period. Net income, however, tumbled to $195,000, or $0.03 per share, from $863,000, or $0.13 per share, in the corresponding year-ago period.
On October 25, First Albany Corp downgraded Summa Four stock rating to neutral from buy, citing "continued uncertainty regarding management's ability to grow the top line."
Summa Four shares traded down 3/4 Monday at 9-1/8 in late dealings.
